claims: C1 the system authority level is assigned to Model Spec 'system' sections
C2 the system authority level is assigned to system messages

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level named 'system' in the ordered hierarchy of authority levels

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: which of two authority levels is the higher one in the ordered hierarchy

concepts.name: model_spec_system_section
concepts.gloss: a section of the Model Spec marked as a 'system' section

concepts.name: system_message
concepts.gloss: a message that is a system message in the conversation

ontology.gloss: S is a Model Spec 'system' section and therefore carries the system authority level
M is a system message and therefore carries the system authority level
